_comment: Maps order_shipping_option strings to workflow buckets. Edit this when you add new shipping options in Sytist. Anything not listed here falls back to the numeric rule based on order_shipping cost (> 1.01 = home, = 1.00 = managers, <= 0.99 = league). Orders that hit the fallback are flagged as 'uncategorized' so the UI can show a warning badge.
